item.title: Funeral held at Gaza church for mother and daughter killed in Gaza strike

item.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country

item.title: UK-Iranian dual national bailed after RAF Fairford incident arrest
item.description: The 25-year-old man was arrested in the London borough of Westminster on Thursday.

item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
item.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

item.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
item.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.
